test-org-element/latex-fragment-parser (testing/lisp/test-org-element.el)
Is the object at point a latex-fragment?

$a$     yes        $a$a    NO (closing $ followed by a letter)
$a$!    yes        $a$,    yes
$a$"    yes        $a$)    yes
"$a$ "  yes        $a$'    yes
$.a$    NO         $,a$    NO
$;a$    NO         "$ a$"  NO (whitespace after opening $)
$a.$    NO         $a,$    NO
"$a $"  NO (whitespace before closing $)
$$a$$   yes        \(a\)   yes        \[a\]   yes
"- $x$" yes (fragment at beginning of an item)
